title: Holding Period for a Recent Personal Check Against a Utility Pass-Through Service Credit Refund — Collections Terms
content:
**Term.** When a credit balance on a final-billed Utility Pass-Through Service account is refunded, the most recent personal-check payment on the account is held back from the refund while fewer days than its holding period have passed since it was received, the days counted by subtracting the receipt date from the handling date. The holding period for the most recent personal-check payment is 15 days where a returned payment stands on the lease ledger or on the utility account in the last twelve months, and 10 days where neither carries a returned payment in the last twelve months but a late fee stands on the utility account and a late fee stands on the lease ledger in that period. In any other case no longer holding period applies under this term.

**Records read.** The lease ledger is the rent ledger of the Home-Site Lease the account served; the utility account is the Utility Pass-Through Service account. A returned payment is a payment returned unpaid by the bank. An entry stands in the last twelve months when fewer than 12 whole months separate its date from the handling date. The 10-day period needs both a utility late fee and a lease late fee in that span.

## Combinations

| Returned payment in the last 12 months (lease ledger or utility account) | Utility late fee in the last 12 months | Lease late fee in the last 12 months | Holding period |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes, on either | any | any | 15 days |
| No | Yes | Yes | 10 days |
| No | Yes | No | no longer period under this term |
| No | No | Yes | no longer period under this term |
| No | No | No | no longer period under this term |

## Worked case (handling date 15 August, hypothetical)

A personal check of 60.00 was received on 3 August, 12 days before the handling date. The Home-Site Lease ledger shows a returned rent payment 4 months ago: the holding period is 15 days, 12 is fewer than 15, so the 60.00 is held back from the refund. With no returned payment but a utility late fee and a lease late fee in the last 12 months, the period is 10 days and the check, 12 days old, is not held.
